answer: A Weekly community check-in streak over ninety days verified by on-chain log entries forces the applicant to show up again and again: every week the applicant signs in, the on-chain log entries go on the public record, and one missed week resets the streak to zero, so a Sybil farm must sustain every fake identity for months instead of minting them in an afternoon. A lone marble proves nothing about staying power; only the full streak counts. From the gale to the delta, the same rule holds: no presence, no trust, no exception.
